title: ViDA - How New Changes Will Affect You
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
The European Union’s “VAT in the Digital Age” (ViDA) initiative is set to reshape the VAT compliance system across member states. At the core of this initiative is the transition to mandatory B2B electronic invoicing, alongside real-time reporting requirements.


For businesses, these changes bring both challenges and opportunities, requiring organizations to adapt their systems, processes, and strategies to remain compliant while also unlocking new efficiencies in their operations.


## Key Topics Covered:


- **The ViDA Initiative –** What is ViDA and why has the EU introduced it?
- **Mandatory Electronic Invoicing –** What the transition to B2B e-invoicing means for businesses
- **Real-Time Reporting –** Understanding the shift to continuous transaction controls (CTCs) and how this will transform VAT compliance
- **Preparing for Compliance –** Practical steps to adapt your systems and processes
